meta.title: Whozzie – Who's it gonna be?
meta.description: Pick someone at random, fairly. Write the names once, then spin a wheel, roll dice, or play the ladder game.

home.heading: Who's it gonna be?
home.lede: Write the names down once. Then spin, roll, or follow the lines to find out.

names.title: Names
names.count: {count, plural, =0 {none yet} one {# name} other {# names}}
names.hint: Paste a list: one name per line, or separated by commas.
names.duplicate: {count, plural, one {{names} is already on the list.} other {{names} are already on the list.}}
names.full: The list holds up to {max} names.
names.empty: No names yet. Add a few above to start.

notFound.title: This page isn't in the notebook
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

wheel.name: Wheel
wheel.summary: Spin it and land on one name.

meta.title: Spin the Wheel – Random Name Picker | Whozzie
meta.description: Enter names, spin the wheel, and let it stop on one. Fair, fast, and free for classrooms, teams, and parties.

wheel.heading: Spin the wheel
wheel.lede: Add names, spin, and see where the pointer stops.
wheel.needNames: Add at least one name to spin.
wheel.wheelLabel: Wheel with {count, plural, one {# name} other {# names}}

dice.name: Dice

meta.title: Roll the Dice – 3D Dice Roller | Whozzie
meta.description: Roll real 3D dice for everyone on your list, or just roll a few. Physics decides who wins.

dice.heading: Roll the dice
dice.lede: Everyone gets a die. Roll them all and see who comes out on top.
dice.everyoneHint: One die per name. The highest roll is picked; ties roll again.
dice.justRollHint: Plain dice, no names. Roll and see the total.
dice.noTable: This browser can't show 3D dice, but you can still roll. The results show below.
dice.needTwo: Add at least two names to roll for everyone, or switch to <just>Just roll</just>.
dice.tooMany: The table fits {max} dice. Remove a few names, or try the <wheel>wheel</wheel>.
dice.tie: Tied at {value}! Just those {count} roll again.
dice.tieBreaks: {count, plural, one {Took # tie-break round.} other {Took # tie-break rounds.}}
dice.justRollIdle: Pick how many dice, then roll.
dice.tableLabel: {count, plural, =0 {Empty dice table} one {Dice table with # die} other {Dice table with # dice}}

ladder.name: Ladder
ladder.summary: Follow the lines to match everyone with a result.

meta.title: Ladder Game – Random Matching | Whozzie
meta.description: Play the ladder game (Amidakuji) online. Enter names and results, then follow the lines to see who gets what.

ladder.heading: Ladder game
ladder.lede: Put names on top and results at the bottom, then follow the lines down.
ladder.hint: Pick a name to follow their line down.
ladder.needNames: Add at least two names to build a ladder.
ladder.tooMany: The ladder fits {max} people. Remove a few names, or try the <wheel>wheel</wheel>.

results.title: Results
results.hint: Results are shuffled and taped over until someone lands on them.
results.locked: Start a new ladder to change results.
results.waiting: Each name gets one result. Add at least two names first.
results.tooMany: The ladder fits {max} people. Remove a few names to set results.
